'''Phinel's Folly''' was a small [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located in the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Vordell]] made a deal with some freelance agents, to swap some surveilance and detection equipment for some [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]]. They agreed to meet on Phinel's Folly to make the transaction, but Vordell was captured by the [[Imperial Customs Corvette|Imperial Customs corvette]] [[Auditor (corvette)|''Auditor'']], before the deal could take place. To buy his freedom, Vordell promised to help the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] recover the rifles. The Imperials agreed and the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] traveled to Phinel's Folly, where Vordell; his crew members [[Kollu]] and [[Trom]]; and a detachment of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], set up an ambush on the moon's surface, to attempt to capture the agents and the rifles.
